Some draw the line at automation decreasing the positions available in an industry (i.e. "robots are taking peoples\' jobs") while others recognize the benefits of automation while maintaining skepticism of artificial intelligence such as ChatGPT (. Personally, I recognize that the efficiency automation brings enables the lifestyle that I currently enjoy and do not consider automation in areas where human participation is objectively less efficient to be particulary egregious. Though I recognize the merits of the "Dystopian view" as the logic appears to be sound, my own opinion differs considering my social anxiety. The rise of automation in traditionally human-dependent fields, such as customer service, may benefit those who struggle with communication, despite potential drawbacks for those who do not. In other words, the issue of automation can never be "solved" per se as each individual\'s perspective has merit. Put simply, the line is drawn based on one\'s priorities, my perspective prioritizes my comfort whereas the "dystopian" view prioritizes society\'s communication.']
